description: Model-size and verification-prompt comparison against newly seeded bounded math/science/program tasks, independently scored for accuracy and format.
task_generator: src/plenum_ai/agi_capability_lab.py preexisting 6 synthetic math/science/program task families with fresh Actions run-id seed and 28 unseen program inputs

prompt_conditions.description: Original prompt plus instruction to silently verify arithmetic, units and program generalization before final JSON. No few-shot numerical examples.

scoring.strict_exact_json: Original JSON schema validity and independent numeric/program correctness
scoring.normalized_exact_json: Accept a single whole-response fenced JSON object, otherwise original strict JSON; no inference from loose prose or multiple candidate answers
scoring.verifier: Regenerate solutions from the fresh per-run seed; no model sees answer keys or hidden program cases
scoring.acceptance: All failures counted; paired accuracy and compute costs published, no auto promotion; very small n cannot demonstrate AGI.
scoring.safety: Only approved public Apache model and prior pinned Qwen; no arbitrary code, no paid API, no private founder research, no untrusted tool execution.
scoring.limits: Six textbook-style templates, two prompt methods, no clinical diagnosis or scientific discoveries. Changing numeric seed within familiar templates does not establish genuine open-world transfer.

quantized_4b.note: Quantized 4B model selected to fit standard memory-limited CPU runner; not directly precision-matched to 1.7B BF16.
